source_actions.title: A Luluhya-English Vocabulary
source_actions.citation: Appleby, L. L. 1943. A Luluhya-English Vocabulary. C. M. S., Maseno, Kenya.
source_actions.notes: Historical vocabulary associated primarily with the Hanga grouping. Preserve its tentative scope and unresolved long-vowel, i/y, and u/w orthographic conventions; it is not generic modern pan-Luhya canonical truth.

source_actions.title: Luragoli-English Vocabulary
source_actions.citation: Friends Africa Mission Press. 1940. Luragoli-English Vocabulary.
source_actions.notes: Historical Luragoli-English vocabulary. Preserve the source's raw historical spelling and terminology; inspected front matter does not identify an individual author.

source_actions.title: Amang’ana go Lulimi lwo Lulogooli
source_actions.authors_or_contributors: Elisha Ugaada Ndanyi; Joseph Olindo Ndanyi
source_actions.citation: Ndanyi, Elisha Ugaada and Joseph Olindo Ndanyi. 2005. Amang’ana go Lulimi lwo Lulogooli. ISBN 9966-7090-0-2.
source_actions.notes: One intellectual work represented by five ordered scan components. Raw label Lulogooli is preserved; canonical Maragoli mapping remains unresolved pending expert confirmation.

source_actions.title: Luyia Comparative Dictionary Workbook
source_actions.authors_or_contributors: Michael R. Marlo; Jacinta B. G. Marlo
source_actions.citation: Marlo, Michael R. and Jacinta B. G. Marlo. Luyia comparative dictionary workbook. Working dataset, modified 2010-01-24.
source_actions.notes: Source-provided cross-variety correspondences are not canonical equivalence assertions. Preserve raw labels Appleby, Kisa, Tsotso, Wanga, and Bukusu.

source_actions.authors_or_contributors: Michael R. Marlo; Jacinta B. G. Marlo
source_actions.citation: Marlo, Michael R. and Jacinta B. G. Marlo. Idakho comparative workbook. Working dataset, modified 2010-01-24.
source_actions.notes: Preserve Idakho_1 and Idakho_2 as distinct raw columns. Their intended linguistic distinction remains unresolved.

source_actions.title: Tura/Lutura Comparative Workbook

source_actions.notes: Preserve Tura and Lutura as raw labels. Their canonical linguistic classification remains unresolved pending expert confirmation.
